lines.en: Hello! I'm your new neighbor next door.
Hello! Welcome. When did you move in?
We moved in yesterday. It's a nice street, right?
Yes, it is. Everyone here smiles and says hello.
lines.ko: 네, 맞아요. 여기 사람들은 모두 웃으며 인사해요.

lines.en: That's good. Do you live here with family?
Yes, with my husband. Come in for tea.
lines.ko: 네, 남편과 살아요. 들어와서 차 한잔해요.

lines.en: Thank you, but I must go now.
I see. We will talk again soon.
Yes! I will bring my family next time.
Great. Have a nice day, my new friend.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 새 친구, 좋은 하루 보내요.

lines.en: Hello? It's Mom. I can't find my key.
When did you last use it?
I locked the front door this morning.
Look in your bag and your coat pocket.
It isn't in my bag or coat.
Don't worry. I have the other key.
lines.ko: 걱정 마요. 저한테 다른 열쇠가 있어요.

lines.en: Can you bring it to the house now?
Yes. I will be there in twenty minutes.
Thank you. I will wait by the door.
Good. Don't leave. Don't worry, it's fine.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 자리 뜨지 말아요. 걱정 마요, 괜찮아요.
